summary: Careful, well-documented preregistered paired study that executed a shared_initial_candidate generate–verify confirmatory design (N=72 pairs) using gpt-5-mini and a deterministic network verifier. Execution and deterministic accounting are thoroughly archived; all baseline emulator runs had zero faults so the paired estimand is degenerate (paired difference = 0.0, McNemar p = 1.0). The manuscript correctly interprets this ceiling outcome, discusses its design implications, and proposes concrete preregisterable alternatives to measure verifier utility under non‑negligible baseline error rates.
critical_issues: References must be presented as a conventional IEEE numbered bibliography with full bibliographic metadata (authors, title, venue, year, DOI/URL as supplemental) rather than DOI/identifier-only or raw-URL entries; verify each reference supports the proximate claim in the text.

Disclosure Statement currently includes run-internal artifact paths and full hashes and reads like an execution manifest. Per the track guidelines, the Disclosure Statement must be concise and must not duplicate execution logs or become a second Methods/Results section.
required_revisions: Replace any identifier-only or URL-only reference entries with full IEEE-style numbered bibliography entries using the verified terminal_bibliographic_records metadata; ensure in-text citations use IEEE numeric markers that point to those formatted entries and confirm each cited record supports the statement it is attached to (no semantic mismatch).

Condense the Disclosure Statement to a concise paragraph that reports the mandatory items (models, adapter/framework, initial master-prompt reference, autonomy-lock boundary, preregistration existence, that artifacts/manifests are archived) but omits file‑level paths and full hashes; point readers to the archived execution manifest (cited by name and hash if desired) for provenance and low-level audit details.
optional_revisions: Add one explicit sentence in Methods stating that recorded temperature = null indicates provider-default sampling semantics and is not evidence of deterministic (temperature=0) sampling, to avoid possible misinterpretation of sampling determinism.

In the Discussion, briefly emphasize (one paragraph) how an independent-generation arm or repair-enabled arm would change the estimand and enable non-degenerate inference, and cross-reference the exact preregistered sensitivity scripts/artifacts that implement those alternatives.

If space permits, replace a small portion of background prose with a 1-paragraph table or bullet listing of follow-on preregistered designs (independent-generation, repair-enabled, adversarial seeding, multi-model) to help readers rapidly evaluate practical next steps.
